title: Minimalistic HUD
description: Tired of a cluttered screen? This pack keeps your HUD compact and out of the way, right under the crosshair
body:
# Minimalistic HUD

Declutter your interface! This resource pack strips away unnecessary visual elements, giving you a much cleaner view of the game world.

## What's Changed:
- **Compact Crosshair:** A sleek, high-precision reticle that won't obstruct your target.
- **Clean Indicators:** Backgrounds have been removed from the health, hunger, and XP bars for a lighter, more modern feel.
- **Translucent Hotbar:** The main bar is 50% transparent, ensuring your UI never gets in the way of the action.
- **Status Effect:** Features new, cleaner backgrounds for status effect icons.
- **Version Support:** 1.21.11 - 26.1.x

---

### Why use it?
Whether you're into PvP, technical builds or you're just tired of the bulky vanilla UI, this pack is for you.

---

### 🐛 Found a bug?
If you spot a misaligned pixel or have a suggestion for improvement, please let me know!

- [**Fill out the error report form**](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSefFTv-vLa00EGqo8tlzeoVXQpsrxF3YH9u3HCXNFlpVIbxxg/viewform?usp=dialog)

Your feedback is essential to the development of **Minimalistic HUD**. Thanks for your support!

> **Release Status:** Core HUD elements and status effect backgrounds are now fully updated.
